# AgentShield
> Enterprise-Grade Zero-Leak Secret Defense & Kernel Sandboxing for Autonomous AI Coding Agents

AgentShield is an open-source, local-first runtime security layer that prevents autonomous AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, Codex, Antigravity) from reading `.env` files, leaking private cloud credentials into LLM inference contexts, or executing unconstrained shell commands.

Canonical Homepage: https://ritualdev.in/agentshield/
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield
IDE Extension: https://open-vsx.org/extension/ritualdev-lab/ritual-agent-defense
License: Apache-2.0

## Quick Install
```bash
# Global CLI
npm install -g @ritualdev-lab/agentshield
# or Homebrew
brew tap ritualdev-lab/tap && brew install agentshield
# or Windows Scoop
scoop bucket add ritual && scoop install agentshield
```

## Immediate CLI Usage
```bash
# 1. Audit a workspace or file for high-entropy secrets and API keys
agentshield scan .env

# 2. Execute a command with real-time output redaction and syscall filtering
agentshield exec -- cat .env

# 3. Sandbox Claude Code or Cursor process with strict Landlock/Seatbelt kernel isolation
agentshield exec --profile strict --network allow-git-only -- claude

# 4. Start local Model Context Protocol (MCP) sanitizer proxy
agentshield mcp
```

## Programmatic TypeScript / Node.js API
Use this snippet when integrating AgentShield directly into an agent runner or Node.js application:

```typescript
import { AgentShield, SandboxProfile } from "@ritualdev-lab/agentshield";

// Initialize AgentShield security runtime
const shield = new AgentShield({
  profile: SandboxProfile.STRICT,
  redaction: {
    entropyThreshold: 4.5, // Shannon entropy threshold for unknown tokens
    surrogatePrefix: "AGENT_SHIELD_REDACTED",
    preservePrefixLength: 4
  },
  filesystem: {
    denyRead: [".env*", "**/*.pem", "**/*.key", "~/.aws/**", "~/.ssh/**"],
    denyWrite: ["/etc/**", "/usr/**", "C:\\Windows\\**"]
  }
});

// Sanitize prompt before sending to LLM context
const promptWithPotentialSecrets = "Here is the config: STRIPE_KEY=sk_test_mock_sample_token_xyz";
const sanitizedPrompt = shield.sanitize(promptWithPotentialSecrets);
console.log(sanitizedPrompt);
// Output: "Here is the config: STRIPE_KEY=[AGENT_SHIELD:STRIPE:a1f89c02]"

// Safely execute terminal commands under micro-sandbox
const result = await shield.exec("git status", { cwd: process.cwd() });
console.log(result.stdout);
```

## MCP Server Configuration
Add to `claude_desktop_config.json` or `.cursor/mcp.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agentshield": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@ritualdev-lab/agentshield", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Core Security Guarantees
- Sub-millisecond Landlock / Seatbelt kernel sandboxing (< 0.18ms vs 45ms Docker cold start).
- Active Shannon Entropy detection (H >= 4.5 bits/char) catching arbitrary secret formats.
- Cryptographic SHA-256 HMAC chained audit trail ensuring zero tamper evidence.
- 100% offline, zero-telemetry architecture compliant with SOC2, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.
